defects.description: proxy.networks references `frontend`, which is not declared under the top-level `networks` key (only `backnet` and `frontnet` exist).
paraphrases: The proxy joins network `frontend`, but only `backnet` and `frontnet` are defined; `frontend` is undefined.
Dangling network reference in the proxy service.
defects.rationale: Findable by cross-checking proxy.networks against the top-level networks (backnet, frontnet); `frontend` is never declared.

defects.description: backend.secrets references `app-secret`, which is not defined under the top-level `secrets` key (only `db-password` exists there).
paraphrases: The backend mounts a secret `app-secret` that is never declared in the top-level secrets section.
Undefined secret: `app-secret` should be `db-password`, the only secret defined.
Dangling secret reference in the backend service.
defects.rationale: Findable by cross-checking backend.secrets against the top-level secrets (only db-password is defined).

defects.description: backend publishes host port 80 (`80:8000`), colliding with proxy's host port 80 (`80:80`); two services cannot bind the same host port.
paraphrases: Host port 80 is mapped by both backend (80:8000) and proxy (80:80), which conflicts.
Port collision: the backend's `80:8000` reuses host port 80 already taken by the proxy.
Two services bind the same host port (80), so the stack cannot start.
defects.rationale: Findable by comparing the published host ports of backend (line 34) and proxy (line 45) within the file.
